narration: Around 700,000 years ago, people settle the Korean Peninsula. Their first state is Gojoseon.
tts_text: Around seven hundred thousand years ago, people settle the Korean Peninsula. Their first state is Go-jo-sun.

narration: Three kingdoms rise. Goguryeo, Baekje, and Silla.
tts_text: Three kingdoms rise. Go-goo-ryuh, Beck-jay, and Shilla.

narration: Goguryeo's King Gwanggaeto pushes into Manchuria. His stele still stands, over six meters tall.
tts_text: Go-goo-ryuh's King Gwahng-geh-toh pushes into Manchuria. His stee-lee still stands, over six meters tall.

narration: In 676, Silla drives out Tang forces and unifies most of the peninsula.
tts_text: In six seventy-six, Shilla drives out Tahng forces and unifies most of the peninsula.

narration: In 918, Wang Geon founds Goryeo. The name Korea comes from it.
tts_text: In nine eighteen, Wahng Gun founds Goryuh. The name Korea comes from it.

narration: In 1377, a Goryeo temple prints Jikji, the oldest surviving metal-type book.
tts_text: In thirteen seventy-seven, a Goryuh temple prints Jeek-jee, the oldest surviving metal-type book.

narration: In 1392, General Yi Seong-gye founds Joseon and makes Seoul its capital.
tts_text: In thirteen ninety-two, General Yee Sung-gyeh founds Jo-sun and makes Seoul its capital.

narration: In 1443, King Sejong creates Hangeul, the Korean alphabet.
tts_text: In fourteen forty-three, King Say-jong creates Hahn-gool, the Korean alphabet.

narration: In 1592, Japan invades. At Myeongnyang in 1597, Yi Sun-sin's 13 ships beat 133.
tts_text: In fifteen ninety-two, Japan invades. At Myung-nyahng in fifteen ninety-seven, Yee Soon-shin's thirteen ships beat one hundred thirty-three.
In nineteen ten, Japan annexes Korea.
On March first, nineteen nineteen, Koreans declare independence.

narration: In 1945, Korea is liberated. The 38th parallel splits the peninsula.
tts_text: In nineteen forty-five, Korea is liberated. The thirty-eighth parallel splits the peninsula.

narration: In 1950, the Korean War begins. An armistice in 1953 ends the fighting.
tts_text: In nineteen fifty, the Korean War begins. An armistice in nineteen fifty-three ends the fighting.

narration: South Korea rebuilds. Five-year plans and exports drive the Miracle on the Hangang.
tts_text: South Korea rebuilds. Five-year plans and exports drive the Miracle on the Hahn Gahng.

narration: On June 29, 1987, the ruling party accepts direct presidential elections.
tts_text: On June twenty-ninth, nineteen eighty-seven, the ruling party accepts direct presidential elections.

narration: In 2024, Han Kang wins Korea's first Nobel Prize in Literature.
